purpose: The grants the telecommunications and ICT development fund paid out in the year, on projects the minister selects.
scope_basis: The fund's statutory purpose is developing telecommunications and ICT, but the statements print grants only as one total with no project list, and the minister who directs it also holds posts; a whole-fund line for a fund whose projects are unnamed is held partial.
amount_scale: full ariary as printed (Unité monétaire : Ariary), with centimes
doc_locator: FDTIC financial statements, year to 31 December 2025, Tableau II *Compte de résultat*, PDF p. 3, line 11 Subventions accordées
notes: Baseline is actual, not appropriated: the fund sits outside the finance law and its own year-end accounts are the only stage printed. Because this row carries no appropriated figure and the year's other rows carry no actual, budget_source --share can no longer compute a domestic share for the year; that is accepted. Charges 100,864,138,246.92 = grants 100,441,652,714.93 + external services 422,485,531.99; income 100,730,385,066.30, of which operator contributions 100,114,754,435.72; net result -133,753,180.62. All foot. The fund is fed by telecom operators' contributions (own-source); its statements name the ministry as the one it answers to, and it receives no transfer in the finance law, so nothing here is counted twice. Unaudited year-end accounts (audited at least every three years, per ARTEC's 2024 report); md5 matched.
